title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Perfect-gas compressible conservative NS and normalization described in report.tex and main.cpp.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured zones, geometric cell/face adjacency and boundary families; METIS on root. No independent geometry oracle.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face residual and global norms implemented; Re20 and M015 inviscid remain nonstationary while metadata calls them converged.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov local Lax–Friedrichs implemented; diffusive relative to sharper fluxes.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip/no-slip and adiabatic wall paths exist; surface rows describe boundary values.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: main.cpp:706–757 least-squares limited face states, called within inner iterations; historical executable not independently bound.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-type limiter and density/pressure face fallback in source; no independent formal-order diagnostic.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: main.cpp:819–831 and :906–913 integrate full viscous traction despite report.tex:16 claim of tangential force; surface Cf :983–989 projects separately. Normal contribution unquantified.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Implicit local relaxation implemented, but steady terminal plateau allows very large force excursions and mislabels Re20/M015 results.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Full BDF residual is recomputed on accepted output state at :1624–45, but convergence ratio/counter use pre-update candidate. Metadata reports1000 misses/30000 and 0.96667 fraction; actual accepted-state ratio not independently established.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS root partition, local meshes, neighbour halo/reductions. np4/8 M015 endpoints differ0.3305 while both histories oscillate strongly; rank-only causation unproven.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
